gaps.existing_behavior: Only two provider literals select inspected byte contracts; new providers return unknown before file checks.
gaps.gap: Research-topic provider identifiers are being used as serialization-format identifiers.
gaps.proposal: Introduce a separate exact format identifier and positive integer version for future acquisitions. Keep provider/topic informational, not a success selector. Unsupported versions remain unknown with no fallback key search.

gaps.gap: 7525 has no kind; 1518 and 1332 use kind but free-text method. Matching saved text does not reproduce extraction.
gaps.proposal: Require an enumerated versioned extraction profile, declared decoder/newline rules, input/output SHA and pinned implementation/tool version for new format. Separate saved-byte binding from optional profile replay. Missing binary-image transcription must not be replaced with empty text or a fabricated source.

gaps.gap: Current verifier does not bind request URL/status/completeness/body completion to source; the 1332 selected record has only legacy retrieved_at, not explicit body completion.
gaps.proposal: New success record needs explicit started/headers/body-completed clocks, complete-body/status/error, response-entity byte semantics and source retrieved_at equality to completion. Preserve old ambiguous clock as legacy, never retroactively infer completion from HTTP Date or newer conventions. Actual DB first-save stays a separate domain.

gaps.gap: Case root differs by source. Nested captures/manifest selectors and authority refs use several local conventions; current verifier only checks its explicit top-level fields.
gaps.proposal: Require one explicit repo-relative case root and root-relative artifact paths plus declared RFC6901 pointer to a record in a SHA-pinned JSON artifact. No bundle-parent fallback, recursive field search or path-base guessing; fail on escapes. Old ../ authority ref is not a currently verified path and must not be silently interpreted under a new root.

gaps.gap: raw bytes and normalized visible text have different transformations; metadata method prose does not establish deterministic source-content lineage for every kind.
gaps.proposal: Keep exact fetched response entity as immutable binary; keep decoder and extraction output separately. For HTML declare node collapse/final newline; for PDF declare layout/form-feed/tool; do not universal-newline-normalize stored text. JSON-derived projections, if added later, need a separate versioned profile and explicit path, not the HTTP text contract by analogy.

gaps.gap: unknown format may hide local byte agreement; matched may be mistaken for publication authenticity, semantic extraction or financial adoption.
gaps.proposal: Report format support, declared byte agreement, transport/source binding, profile reproduction and citation byte binding separately; leave authenticity/meaning/adoption explicitly unverified. Preserve existing legacy result rather than replacing it with new semantics.

gaps.gap: Verifier explicitly does not derive IDs; adding metadata/version to an existing source can change its immutable snapshot or shared ID inputs.
gaps.proposal: Use common stable_source_id only for new sources under its recorded input contract. Do not mutate/re-ID old sources. Later adapter evidence is a separately timestamped immutable sidecar pinned to original snapshot/file SHA, never a claim that a historical capture used the new format.

gaps.gap: Matching a stored response does not authorize another GET or prove current robots/site access.
gaps.proposal: Transport may reference saved robots/UA/hold-decision evidence with exact artifact SHA/path/pointer. Such records remain acquisition evidence; byte verification neither follows links nor overrides later exact-host collection holds. Do not retrofit current holds to earlier acquisition chronology.

future_format_recommendation.scope: Future HTTP response entity and extraction record only, not SDK normalized row/financial adoption.

source_binding_proposed.record_pointer: explicit RFC6901 pointer, empty string selects root
source_binding_proposed.source_snapshot_sha256: models.json_text(source) UTF-8 SHA, algorithm named; not RFC8785

failure_semantics_proposed.malformed_recognized_contract: validation_error including missing required fields, never matched
failure_semantics_proposed.all_declared_byte_bindings_agree: only declared-byte agreement; other dimensions remain separate
failure_semantics_proposed.known_artifact_absent_or_optional_eviden: unknown with named reason; missing required schema fields instead validation_error

future_targeted_verification_cases_not_r: Exact format/version and bool-as-int rejection; missing/wrong extraction profile
CRLF vs LF mismatch without universal newline conversion; PDF form-feed preserved
Explicit empty-root/nested JSON pointer, escaped keys, malformed ~ escape, missing pointer, duplicate/nonfinite JSON
Absolute/../NUL/symlink path escape rejected; explicit alternate case roots accepted
Completed timestamp binding and partial/non-200 capture retained as failure; legacy clock unknown not backfilled
Unknown provider with recognized new format may be byte-checkable only after implementation; unknown format with familiar provider does not fall back
Old unknown and legacy matched results unchanged; sidecar does not re-ID or rewrite old source
Byte agreement never changes meaning/adoption/current GET permission
